scope: One fixed whole-workflow invocation per each of six cases; not engine-only or universal speed
interpretation: Applies only to these pinned inputs, artifact, settings and host. A suite win does not imply every case wins; all case results are reported without selection.

method.suite_metric: sum of case native arithmetic mean wall times / sum of case reference arithmetic mean wall times
method.weighting: one complete fixed workload per dataset/preset; no mean of ratios or speedups
method.bootstrap: percentile95%; independently resample complete paired repetition indexes within each case, then ratio of sums of case means; case intervals use the same joint draws
method.case_intervals: pointwise95%, not simultaneous family-wise intervals; fixed-suite interval is primary
method.classification: win iff CIupper<1; regression iff CIlower>1; otherwise inconclusive
method.trial_exclusion: only predeclared warmups excluded; all measured trials/outliers retained
method.workflow_difference: reference uses two processes and fresh on-disk v5 storage; native uses one process and in-memory storage
method.timing_boundary: workflow wall: immediately before build/native subprocess through complete search/native captured stdout+stderr; excludes temporary directory creation/deletion, pin verification, parity checks and reporting
method.raw_observations: all original reports, pairs and warmups embedded below without omissions

common_identity.cache_policy: warm-cache workflow measurements; no filesystem/page-cache eviction or flushing
common_identity.timing_boundary: workflow wall: immediately before build/native subprocess through complete search/native captured stdout+stderr; excludes temporary directory creation/deletion, pin verification, parity checks and reporting
common_identity.workflow_difference: reference uses two processes and fresh on-disk v5 storage; native uses one process and in-memory storage
common_identity.output_policy: both sides capture all 19 fields into Python memory on every run; compare outside timed intervals
common_identity.precision: exact ordered non-floating fields; compare_search.py BLAST CLI precision rules for Evalue/bit score
